## Description {#details}

<p>This file defines an InstructionCost class that is used when calculating the cost of an instruction, or a group of instructions.</p>


<p>In addition to a numeric value representing the cost the class also contains a state that can be used to encode particular properties, such as a cost being invalid. Operations on InstructionCost implement saturation arithmetic, so that accumulating costs on large cost-values don't overflow.</p>
